title: Saker Honing Guide Tool

Transform your sharpening experience with the New Angle Fixing Tool, designed to secure and fine-tune the angle where the chisel edge meets the whetstone, allowing the entire knife edge to be sharpened uniformly. Say goodbye to uneven edges and hello to precise, consistent sharpening.

FEATURES

  • Precise Angle Adjustment for Uniform Sharpening: The New Angle Fixing Tool allows you to secure and fine-tune the sharpening angle, ensuring the entire knife edge is sharpened uniformly.   • Wide Roller for Stability: With a widened bearings-roller at the bottom, you can easily scroll back and forth to sharpen your chisel. The wider wheels provide greater stability, eliminating the worry of tipping the jig during use and ensuring that your work is done rigorously and smoothly.
  • Durable All-Metal Construction: Crafted from aluminum alloy, the body of the honing guide is heavy enough to support the weight of most chisels. It is wear-resistant, anti-corrosion, and will never rust, even after years of use.

Why Choose SAKER® Honing Guide Tool?

  • Uniform Sharpening: The precise angle adjustment ensures a consistent edge across the entire blade.
  • Versatile Compatibility: Easily adjust to fit a wide range of chisel and planer blade sizes.
  • Enhanced Stability: The wide roller design prevents tipping, providing a smooth sharpening experience.
  • Durable Build: Made from high-quality aluminum alloy, this tool is built to last and resist corrosion.

How to Use

1.Set Up the Tool: Secure the chisel or planer blade in the honing guide by adjusting the knob to fit the width.

2.Adjust the Angle: Fine-tune the angle where the chisel edge meets the whetstone by adjusting the distance between the top of the chisel and the honing guide.

3.harpen Your Tool: Scroll back and forth using the wide roller to achieve a uniform edge.
